scholarships: 12,000 Student Activities Fund To support co-curricular and extra-curricular activities a Student Activities Fund has been formed.
Merit Scholarships for Bachelor Students Merit scholarship is awarded to the Top Three position holders of each Examination Board in the year of admission.
Merit Scholarship is also offered to Top Three position holders in the merit list of NU admission merit list of each campuses.

This scholarship is for four years of un-interrupted studies with standard courses (core and elective), labs and final year projects of the degree offered by the department in a semester to a batch with a specified number of total credit hours and is equal to the full tuition fee.
A student registering for less or more credit hours than the total specified number of credit hours shall not be eligible for Merit Scholarship.
Continuation of merit scholarship is subject to maintaining semester GPA of 3.0 or higher.
Scholarship covers full tuition fee for the entire duration of the program, renewable every year.
